create_function_repeat: create a column of length n filled with a given value using polars repeat function
create_function_ones: create a column of length n filled with ones using polars ones function
create_function_zeros: create a column of length n filled with zeros using polars zeros function
test_function_repeat_eager: test the polars repeat function with eager=True to return a Series directly
test_function_repeat_lazy: test the polars repeat function with eager=False to return an Expr for lazy evaluation
